title: hubble-tension
description: The Hubble tension as an intra-scott stage-offset: H₀ is a growth rate = the thermalization-spiral inflation factor λ read at a stage. Both pipelines read the one classical-spacetime (cosmic-scott, κ=ω, golden φ) spiral at different stages τ — the CMB at early scott (a past join propagated forward by flow), the distance ladder at the present observer-stage. The ~67-vs-~73 km/s/Mpc disagreement is the H¹ obstruction to gluing two stage-readings of an unconverged thermalization into one global section; it is the fixed signature of the field being not-yet-thermal (κ=ω), removed only by full thermalizing (= heat death), not gradually. A third resolution beside close-H¹ and new-physics.
